turnout.notes: Vermont turnout rows remain on EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows. Official SOS turnout JSON/PDF leads are retained, but not active, because SOS JSON registered voters (517,051), canvass cover-page registered voters (522,600), and EAC fallback registered voters (500,986) require denominator-timing review.

certifiedResults.statewideSummaryRowHandling: Exclude the federal JSON row with tid 0 / tn STATE WIDE before aggregating town/reporting-district rows; it duplicates the statewide totals.

reviewCharts.warning: Vermont review rows pair official static JSON President rows with same-grain U.S. Senate rows after excluding the duplicated STATE WIDE summary row. U.S. Senate includes a major independent candidate, so Democratic/Republican dropoff fields are directional source-review inputs only. Town/reporting-district geometry is not loaded; county map rows are aggregated from the manifest county crosswalk.

historicalBaselines.warning: Vermont 2020 historical rows are county aggregate context generated from the official SOS municipality export using the official 2024 static manifest county crosswalk. They are not town/reporting-district review rows and should be used as county-level baseline context only.
